Subagents and commands no longer look the same in the `/desk-activity` timeline when your theme gives them the same color.

- Agent runs are now drawn as a double line `═`, and commands keep the heavy line `━`, in both the lanes and the legend. Before, both used `━` and were told apart only by color, so in custom themes where the `claude` and `planMode` colors are close (for example, two shades of blue) you could not tell them apart

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
